snippet.title: MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM GUNDAM BATTLE OPERATION 3　Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Suit up and sortie in the latest installment in the MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM BATTLE OPERATION series!

The epic free-to-play team combat game set in the Mobile Suit Gundam universe. Enlist as a mercenary, pilot legendary mobile suits, and fight together to conquer the battlefield in Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 3! 

Official Website：https://bobobo-sp.ggame.jp/en/

Official X：https://x.com/GBO_EN

Official Discord：http://discord.gg/GBO3

Official Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/GBO3.EN

■Wishlist now
PlayStation(R)5：https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10011044
STEAM(R)：https://store.steampowered.com/app/2303000
